entities.name: UniProt Q1GFQ6
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to supplied 226-aa sequence; reviewed Ruegeria sp. TM1040 protein annotated as orotate phosphoribosyltransferase (EC 2.4.2.10).
Catalyzes orotate + PRPP → orotidine 5'-phosphate (OMP) + diphosphate; enzyme annotation maps to Rhea RHEA:10380.
Annotated in de novo UMP biosynthesis and pyrimidine nucleobase biosynthesis; GO:0004588, GO:0044205, GO:0019856; magnesium-ion-binding annotation GO:0000287.
Contains Pribosyltran (PF00156) domain at residues 75–164 in the sequence analysis.

entities.name: De novo UMP biosynthesis
observations: Orotate phosphoribosyltransferase performs the orotate-to-OMP step, the first step of UMP biosynthesis from orotate.

entities.name: Orotate to OMP
observations: Orotate + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate (PRPP) ⇌ orotidine 5'-phosphate (OMP) + diphosphate; Rhea RHEA:10380; enzyme EC 2.4.2.10.
